question: Two stations A and B are 1800 km apart. A train starts from A towards B at 7 A.M. at a speed of 100 km/h. Another train starts from B towards A at 8 A.M. on the same day at a speed of 325 km/h. At what time will they cross each other?
solution:

Speed of the train starting from A at 7 A.M. = 100 km/h
